items.title: Frasers Group takes control of Hugo Boss after all
items.summary: Frasers Group has acquired a majority stake in Hugo Boss and is now fully integrating the German fashion company into its group. With an additional share purchase, the British retailer has surpassed the 50% threshold, despite a previous rejected takeover bid.

items.title: Number of Asian packages delivered via PostNL falls by a third
items.summary: In the third quarter, PostNL delivered 32% fewer packages from Asia. The new European import duty on small shipments is clearly having an impact on the Dutch package delivery company. The number of packages delivered via the airport has also already dropped significantly.

items.title: EU Approves Slovenia’s Fuel Cost Aid Package For Farming And Fisheries
items.summary: The European Commission approves Slovenia’s €500,000 aid scheme to help agriculture, fisheries and aquaculture firms facing high fuel costs.

items.title: Double-digit growth for Dia in Spain
items.summary: Dia closed the third quarter in Spain with revenue growth of 11.3%. The chain attributes this increase to more customers and a faster pace of store openings. Revenue also grew at a double-digit rate at the group level.
